notes.title: The Tribe Game is out now! Keep the dream alive!
notes.content:
In The Tribe Game, the player creates their own custom character with a unique look and explores an atmospheric post-apocalyptic world (where hope prevails), becoming instrumental in creating a better future. Inspired by the classic cult-hit TV series, 'The Tribe'.

Now available to play on Steam, the game has storylines, characters and location settings that will be familiar to anyone who has watched TV series... and to newcomers or those unfamiliar with the world of The Tribe, they will quickly discover who are the other protagonists of this world. Some will be friendly, some will be hostile, some in need, while others threaten the future of the already fragile world.

The game can be played in English (or German) by selecting the language setting in your Steam launcher.  It is also playable on Windows PC or MacOS.

The Tribe Game is from the Cloud 9 Screen Entertainment Group (the makers of The Tribe TV series) and includes music and sound effects from the series and also has an introduction cinematic with audio from Beth Allen herself (who played Amber in the television series) in the English language version of the game! The game comes with some special features including a special message from the Creator of The Tribe TV series (who has also overseen the official game), a video showing artwork evolution and some clips from the series.

There are many diverse places to explore, quests to be accomplished, professions to level up, items and resources to be found, battles to be won, friendships to be made and adversaries to be challenged... as the player experiences all of the humour and unpredictable drama in the world of The Tribe - and tries to keep their own (and their tribe's) dreams alive.
